description: Find businesses and places on Google Maps by a text query, optionally around a point. Each result is the full listing: place_id, name, categories, formatted_address, location, rating and user_ratings_total, phone, website, opening_hours and business_status — named as in Google's Places API. Use this to build a list of businesses in an area; use google-maps/place when you already have a place_id. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

country.description: Two-letter country code to bias results, e.g. `us`.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

language.description: Two-letter language code for localised text, e.g. `en`, `de`.

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search around.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–20. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

lng.description: Longitude of the point to search around.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "coffee shops in Brooklyn" or "dentist".

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around lat/lng.

name: search_places
title: Search Google Maps for businesses and places
